# Install
Download the installer, verify its checksum, then run it:
curl -fsSLO https://example.invalid/releases/v1.2.3/install.sh
sha256sum -c install.sh.sha256 && bash install.sh
pip install git+https://github.com/example-org/helper.git@4f2a9c1d8e7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a99887766554433
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/example-org/guard/4f2a9c1d8e7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a99887766554433/guard.py
